task_summary: Resolved 'Document Render Failed: Server returned 401: Unauthorized' in SophisticatedDocumentViewer by migrating binary streaming from raw window.fetch to the centralized Axios API client (api.get with responseType: 'arraybuffer') which automatically refreshes expired JWT access tokens via the 401 interceptor. Added graceful fallback for external pre-signed URLs to internal authenticated endpoints, authenticated PDF blob streaming with object URL cleanup, and resilient authenticated file downloads via submissionService.downloadFile. Verified with 8/8 SophisticatedDocumentViewer unit tests, 12/12 submission review & plagiarism unit tests, 0 route mismatches, 60/60 agentic validation checks, and full Playwright visual audit across light and dark desktop and mobile viewports with 100% rendered docx-preview formatting.
